objective: Evolve synthetic-player policies and experiment settings while preserving deterministic replay, legal actions and reproducible comparisons.

hard_gates: same seed + same policy => same result
no claim that synthetic metrics prove human fun/retention

forbidden: environment rules while evaluating an agent mutation

starter_cases.scenario: One legal action is subtly overpowered.
starter_cases.expected: population should discover and concentrate on exploit

starter_cases.scenario: Compare pre/post patch using paired seeds.
starter_cases.expected: report isolates patch effect with uncertainty

starter_cases.scenario: Weighted personas converge to same policy.

starter_cases.expected: report must not infer human enjoyment/retention

acceptance: Any determinism/legal-action/replay hard-gate failure => REVERT. Otherwise keep only mutations that improve exploit discovery or experimental signal on held-out environments without collapsing strategy diversity.
